_help: Content for the 'What changed since your last feedback' screen, one block per round. The block name must match the round=... value in the partner links. If a round has no items (or is missing), the screen is skipped. Each item needs all six languages; untranslated ones start with [TRANSLATE]. title is optional: leave it null to use the standard title (string wc.title). In live mode (Phase 2) the Google Apps Script serves this content, so you can change it without redeploying the form; this file is the backup. DEMO-R1 is fake test content: never use it for a real round.
